summary: This stage executed an exceptionally thorough and well-calibrated static audit of the paper and repository without downloading the embedding files. It discovered major methodological discrepancies, including the use of LinearSVC instead of LDA, the operator precedence bug in doPCA, and the complete absence of code for word similarity and word translation. It correctly resolved the MWEAT aggregate statistic formula (T2) against the rendered PDF, while uncovering p-value mismatches, noun-list leakage, and definitional pair shifts. The stage avoided all listed false claims and maintained exemplary calibration across all findings.
